            // So greedy left-to-right is optimal: pair i with i+3 if both available

            // For len=9: 0-3,1-4,2-5,3-6 no (3 used), so 0-3,1-4,2-5,6-9 no -> 3 pairs?

            // Known solution for this problem: 
            // For 1×n board, answer = n - n%2 if n%6 != 4 and n%6 != 5
            // answer = n - n%2 - 2 if n%6 == 4 or n%6 == 5
            
            long len_board = n * m; // since one dimension is 1

        if (n > m) {
